_note: Where an installed Supersuit (formerly Freedom) keeps its versioned plugin copies, newest product name first. The ONE list every ABU board resolver reads (display.py, works-board.mjs, mount.mjs, shot-board.mjs); FREEDOM_CACHE_DIR overrides it. The product was renamed Freedom -> Supersuit on 2026-10-14 and its cache moved from freedom-workspace/freedom to supersuit/supersuit; with only the old root listed, every board on a Supersuit machine reported 'no Freedom install' and fell back to a text card (2026-11-23).
